summary: Faz 8 · CP3 Rol-Bazlı Görünürlük & Cross-Company end-to-end verification. Backend: 12/12 new CP3 tests (task assignee_user_id RBAC + /api/team/members + /api/team/summary) PASS + 117/117 CP1/CP2 regression suites PASS (129/129 total). Frontend: 4/5 review scenarios PASS (mgr_test tab-team + Ekibim panel + emp1_test row + admin/emp1_test/ahmet role gating). 1 CRITICAL UI bug found: for role='manager' with default workspace_mode='personal', the task-assignee-select container is rendered with display:none because auth.js:115 defines isTeamView = role==='admin' || workspace_mode==='team' and does NOT include 'manager'. Managers therefore cannot assign tasks via the UI dropdown unless they first flip workspace_mode to 'team' — the whole primary CP3 UX flow is silently blocked out-of-the-box.

ui_bugs.issue: isTeamView = user.role === 'admin' || workspace_mode === 'team'  — MISSING 'manager' role. mgr_test has workspace_mode='personal' by default (verified via GET /api/auth/me), so the whole assignee/company grid is display:none for managers. task-assignee-select is present in DOM but not visible, options include the correct 'Kendime ata' + 'emp1_test · Test Company A' entries. Managers can technically still submit tasks (without assignee) but the CP3 primary flow is broken. Suggested fix: include manager in isTeamView (`user?.role === 'admin' || user?.role === 'manager' || workspace_mode === 'team'`), OR auto-set workspace_mode='team' when a user is promoted to manager, OR gate the assignee container on teamMembers.length > 0 instead of isTeamView.

rca of the issue: CP1 (iter 42) introduced role='manager' as a first-class role. CP2/CP3 built endpoint RBAC around visible_user_ids() which correctly treats manager as team-scope. But the frontend derived flag `isTeamView` in lib/auth.js was authored during pre-manager era: `user?.role === 'admin' || workspace_mode === 'team'`. When CP3 added the manager-owned assignee-select gated on isTeamView, no one updated the flag. mgr_test's default workspace_mode='personal' therefore hides the entire assignee/company grid via inline style. Reproduction: login mgr_test → Görevler → task-add-toggle → observe [data-testid=task-assignee-select] present but its parent div has style='display:none'. Mitigation: single-line change to include 'manager' in isTeamView (auth.js:115).
